text.tspan: Share of countries by gender of the chief executive World
"Chief executive" is defined here as the head of state or the head of government, whoever has more power over
the appointment and dismissal of cabinet ministers.

tspan.tspan: This is recorded on December 31 of each year. When the head of state and head of government hold equal power, the head of

text.tspan: government is considered the chief executive.
